taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: AWS STS web-identity role trust; not end-user OAuth login

controls.boundary: AWS workload OIDC role trust and claim binding — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Inspect OIDC issuer configuration, role trust policy, subject/audience conditions and the CI job's actual token claim shape. Separate trust to assume a role from permissions after assumption.
controls.controlled_verification: Compare claim sets for the intended repository/environment and a prohibited owned fixture context. Determine whether trust distinguishes repository, branch/environment and event context as required by deployment policy. A locally simulated claim comparison is not an actual AWS role session.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A trusted issuer URL alone does not bind a particular workflow. A broad subject pattern may be intentional for a multi-repo role; establish the required boundary and other effective conditions.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind trust to the intended issuer/audience/subject context and limit the role's effective authority. Retest legitimate deployment and the originally prohibited claim context.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
